description: Books a ride in Addis Ababa at the fixed fare from quote_ride. It sends a real driver, so it takes the pickup, drop-off, tier, fare and the rider's Ethiopian phone number as the user confirmed them. A dispatcher assigns a driver; the rider is contacted on the phone given. Returns the ride id and a live tracking link. To book for someone else (e.g. a relative in Addis while you are abroad), pass passenger_name and passenger_phone; rider_name/rider_phone are then the booker and may be a foreign number.

dropoff.description: Drop-off: a place name in Addis Ababa (e.g. "Edna Mall", "Bole Airport", "Piassa") or "lat,lng" like "9.0108,38.7578". Prefer the dropoff_coords from quote_ride.

passenger_name.description: Book for someone else: the passenger's name (the driver calls the passenger)

passenger_phone.description: Book for someone else: the passenger's Ethiopian mobile (09… or +2519…)

pickup.description: Pickup: a place name in Addis Ababa (e.g. "Edna Mall", "Bole Airport", "Piassa") or "lat,lng" like "9.0108,38.7578". Prefer the pickup_coords from quote_ride.

rider_name.description: Rider's name (or the booker's name when booking for someone else)

rider_phone.description: Ethiopian mobile: 09XXXXXXXX or +2519XXXXXXXX (any number if booking for someone else)

name: request_ride

booked_for.description: Passenger name when booked for someone else

driver.description: Assigned driver, null until one is assigned

duplicate.description: true when the same booking was already made

next_step.description: What to tell the user now

note.description: How to use or present this result

requested_at.description: When the ride was requested (ISO time)

ride_id.description: Ride id (needed for get_ride_status and cancel_ride)

source_url.description: bina.et page this result comes from; cite it

status.description: dispatching, assigned, arriving, arrived, ontrip, completed, cancelled, or test_booking

test.description: true for a reviewer test booking (no driver is sent)

title: Book a BinaSmart ride
